statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v w : V) :
  ⟪u - v,w⟫ = ⟪u,w⟫ - ⟪v,w⟫
name: LinearAlgebraGame.inner_minus_left
content:
`inner_minus_left` extends linearity of the inner product in the first argument to subtraction:
`⟪u - v, w⟫ = ⟪u, w⟫ - ⟪v, w⟫`.
